run_hot3d_viewer_cli: run the hot3d data viewer CLI to visualize a sequence folder with rerun
run_execute_rerun: run execute_rerun to log hot3d sequence data to a rerun session or .rrd file
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get command line arguments for the hot3d viewer including sequence and object library paths

review_Hot3DVisualizer: review the Hot3DVisualizer usage for logging static and dynamic assets to rerun
